flashcard_questions.q: Things that stay the same over time.
New developments, ideas, or practices that represent a break from the past.
The theory that disease was caused by 'bad air' or foul-smelling vapours rising from rotting matter, swamps, or sewage.
What was the belief that a reigning monarch could cure scrofula by laying hands on the sufferer called?

flashcard_questions.a: An ancient Greek theory that the body held four liquids — blood, phlegm, yellow bile and black bile — which had to stay in balance for good health.
